children.value: > Fact From Story The World Cup returned to India after 1996
> > Fact From Story The last time India welcomed the ODI Cricket World Cup was in 2011, when they were co-hosts with Sri Lanka and Bangladesh.
> > > Fact From Story Pakistan were barred from hosting due to terrorist attacks on the Sri Lankan team when touring the country a couple of years prior to the World Cup.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Terrorist attacks make it unsafe to host large events.
> Fact From Story India moved to finals and beat Sri Lanka to win their second World Cup title.
> Commonsense Knowledge Therefore, India hosted the world cup again after 15 years.
